name: attack
description: Taking action to damage someone's body, identity, or assets without their consent and for your benefit or the benefit of an important other.
perceptions: That person has something I want or resent.
The only way to get it or even things up is to take action.

variations.name: open hostility
variations.description: An state of tension between multiple people or groups where each side knows the other intends to advance or defend their interests with physical or social force.
perceptions: My group or I are struggling with another group or person for some objective.
There will be social or physical conflict.

variations.name: sabotage
variations.description: Effort to damage something that belongs to someone else without their consent or knowledge.
perceptions: This asset is valuable to someone who I'm hostile with.
Damaging or destroying it will slow their efforts.
I can't let them know I'm doing it or they could defend it.

variations.name: attacking life or health of a person
variations.description: Taking action to seriously injure or kill another person.
perceptions: This person, or a group they represent, is dangerous to me or has something I need.
A peaceful resolution does not seem possible or desirable.

variations.name: committing a violent crime
variations.description: Using socially unsactioned physical force to harm, rape, or kill another person.
perceptions: I want something from this person or I have orders to get it.
It may be against the rules, but I don't care.
I don't care if they are harmed by my action.
They deserve the treatment or I deserve the reward.
related: attacking life or health of a person

variations.name: attacking life or health of a non-person
variations.description: Taking action to seriously injure or kill someone or something that is not a person, for example an animal or an organization.
perceptions: This agent or group, is dangerous to me or has something I need.
A peaceful resolution does not seem possible or desirable.

variations.name: attacking reputation
variations.description: Taking action to degrade the social status of another.
perceptions: This person, or a group they represent, is dangerous to my status or I could benefit from their downgrade.

variations.name: damage for spite
variations.description: Damaging something of value to someone else to negatively effect another.
perceptions: A person or group values this thing.
They will be affected negatively if it's damaged or destroyed.

commentaries.quote: Advancing an agenda at the expense of others often creates conflict in the short term. If it's done in way that minimizes unnecessary damage, others may come to see the wisdom. Otherwise, it may set up a chain of resentful actions.

History is a dense timeline of people attacking each other for every conceivable reason, so the cult of the warrior has had a lot of time in the sun. That doesn't mean that every human is violent by nature, but it may be worth observing that aggression and cooperation can be tapped for intentions both good and bad.
The best defense is a good offense.
